create_DatasetMapperTTA: create a DatasetMapperTTA instance to generate augmented image dataset dicts for test-time augmentation
build_GeneralizedRCNNWithTTA: build a GeneralizedRCNNWithTTA wrapper to run detection inference with test-time augmentation on a GeneralizedRCNN model
test_DatasetMapperTTA_call: test the DatasetMapperTTA callable to produce resized and flipped image variants from a single input dataset dict
run_GeneralizedRCNNWithTTA_call: run GeneralizedRCNNWithTTA inference on a batch of inputs to get merged detections with improved accuracy from TTA
review_GeneralizedRCNNWithTTA_merge_dete: review the GeneralizedRCNNWithTTA._merge_detections method that combines all augmented box predictions using NMS
